text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD: #INC-4021) — inference-queue-depth > 95th percentile and autoscaler heartbeats missing for 90s

maria: saw this spike on dashboards too, queue depth jumped to ~120k messages, tail latency 2.3s -> 15s for a subset. customers reporting 502/504s.

kevin: acked PD. I'm on it. grabbing metrics.

sam: pinging autoscaler logs now, looks like scale-up requests queued but not provisioning. possible cloud quota exhaustion?

priya: re-runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/autoscaler-backlog — follow scale-up fallback section if CA can't allocate nodes.

maria: copy, putting incident channel in header. customer-impact: several enterprise customers on dedicated had degraded throughput, some api keys showing high error rates. posted note to status page draft.

kevin: autoscaler logs snippet:```text
I0322 14:07:03 autoscaler-controller.go:211] ScaleUp: request for 16 pods, nodesNeeded=4
I0322 14:07:18 cloudprovider.go:487] Failed to create node: quotaExceeded: Insufficient CPU quota in region us-west1
I0322 14:07:21 autoscaler-controller.go:231] Heartbeat missed, last heartbeat 94s ago
```

sam: confirmed cloud quota error from provider UI. quota for n2-highmem exhausted in us-west1. No auto-replenish.

priya: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce per-request capacity (throttle lower-priority routes), 2) scale down non-critical workloads, 3) manual node pool bump if allowed.

maria: initiating throttling rule on router, lowering concurrency for non-prod and low-tier customers. This should drop incoming tokens by ~30%. applying now.

kevin: running manual node pool increase (GCP). command:```bash
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-inference-usw1 --size 24 --region us-west1
```
kevin: gcloud response: "Resizing accepted, but creation failing: Quota 'CPUS' exceeded."

nate: jumping in — I'll open quota request with Cloud Support and also request temporary burst quota. raising case now (case #CS-7762). ETA unknown (usually 1-3h).

priya: while we wait, can we evict some batch/experimental jobs? those run on dedicated pool 'batch-noncritical'.

sam: yes I queued eviction. kubectl drain --selector=pool=batch-noncritical - ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data. commands:```bash
kubectl get pods -n infra -l job=batch -o name | xargs -r kubectl delete -n infra
```

maria: throttling is taking effect, queue depth down to ~80k, p50/p95 latency improving slightly. still seeing errors for some customers who rely on pinned capacity.

kevin: PD escalation: submitted timeline and current actions, escalating to platform SRE for node pool override.

incident-bot: PD update — INC-4021 acknowledged by kevin at 14:10:12; escalated to platform@redwood at 14:13:07.

nate: Cloud Support created temporary quota increase request with "urgent" label. also requested spot vs on-demand fallback; provider might allow more spot CPU.

sam: quick workaround: deploy a cheap quantized model variant to lower-throughput nodes to offload some requests. rolling canary now to 10% traffic for rerouting.```

maria: traffic split configured to route low-priority affordance to q8 model variant. check: https://dash.redwood.ai/routes/inference/traffic-split

kevin: after routing + eviction + throttling queue down to ~42k, error rate dropped 70%. enterprise customers still degraded — they were on dedicated pools which we can't auto-burst.

priya: Handoff plan: I'm primary until quota confirmed. If provider ETA > 30m, we should trigger contractual on-call with cloud account manager. Maria, can you prepare customer comms? highlight mitigation steps and ETA TBD.

maria: drafting message for affected customers and status page with current mitigations and next steps. will post in #customer-success and #status once approved.

kevin: docs updated in thread: applied runbook steps 1-4. still waiting on quota.

nate: cloud support replied: provisional quota granted for 2h while they review ticket. provisioning allowed for up to +40 CPUs. manual node creation attempt accepted.

kevin: manual node create now succeeded, nodes joining cluster. kubectl get nodes:```text
NAME                                STATUS   ROLES    AGE
node-infer-045   Ready    <none>   2m
node-infer-046   Ready    <none>   1m
```

sam: autoscaler heartbeats resumed, scale-up continued and queued pods scheduling. queue drained below 10k now.

maria: posting customer update and closing PD timeline with status: mitigated, partial degradation, follow-up: quota increase and postmortem.

kevin: handing off to priya for follow-up and postmortem. I'll be reachable if needed. :thumbsup:

priya: ack handoff. I'll open a postmortem ticket and include recommended runbook changes: - add quota monitor alert pre-warn 70% CPU quota, - automated fallback to q8 variant earlier, - playbook for on-call to request cloud account manager.

incident-bot: Thread marked resolved in PD (INC-4021) at 14:32:30 by kevin.

maria: thanks everyone. logging timeline for PMs and compliance.

kevin: short action items: [kevin] follow up on permanent quota, [priya] postmortem, [maria] customer comms, [sam] add automation to evict batch jobs earlier.

nate: +1 on quota follow-up. will also keep temporary quota case open until we secure permanent increase.

maria: closing thread once postmortem link posted.
